# ParseGlob reads the file system at run time, which muxt cannot follow. The
# error names the supported alternative.

! muxt generate
stderr 'unsupported function ParseGlob: use ParseFS with an embed.FS'

! muxt check
stderr 'unsupported function ParseGlob: use ParseFS with an embed.FS'
